subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
subcategory: Privacy Laws That Changed the World
title: GDPR — The Gold Standard
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on GDPR — The Gold Standard.

hook.text: In 2018, one regulation changed how every company on Earth handles European personal data.

buildup.text: The General Data Protection Regulation requires consent, transparency, and the right to delete your data.

discovery.text: GDPR applies to any company serving EU residents — even if based in Silicon Valley or Shanghai.

twist.text: Fines can reach 4% of global revenue. For a company like Google, that's billions of dollars.

climax.text: GDPR proved that one region's laws can reshape global business practices overnight.

quiz.question: Why does GDPR affect companies outside Europe?
options: It applies to any company that processes data of EU residents
